abstract.t: This document specifies the did:alter Decentralized Identifier method. A did:alter identifier names a ~handle together with the DNS zone that publishes the handle's signed envelope, and it resolves to a DID document by running the envelope recognition procedure of the companion specification for discovering Model Context Protocol servers through DNS TXT records, then expressing the verified envelope's Ed25519 key as a verification method. The identifier agrees with the handle grammar of the alter URI scheme and with the did:alter form already written by the identity-attributed commits specification. The method defines no record, cryptographic primitive or registry of its own. Its create, update and deactivate operations publish, replace and revoke that envelope, and its read operation verifies it. The document also sets out what the method cannot yet do, because the envelope record it reads carries no key history, and revocation cannot presently be observed from DNS alone.
